title: Ing talasuyu ning makasalikut a kabiasnan
intro: keng malawak a tapestry da reng Quranic narratives, atin yang makatalakad a enigmatic a pigura, metung a talasuyu nang Allah a mipagkalub king banal a beluan at lunus. Ining misteryosung indibidwal ayni mekatagmu ya keng metung kareng pekamaragul a propeta, a magdalang pamaglakbe a mitmung makalitu a dapat a linaban kareng limitasyun ning pamanintindi ning tau. Balang dapat, agyang balamu e makatuliran, magsalikut yang malalam a aral tungkul keng kapalaran, pasensya, ampo ing e mayayakit a kabiasnan keng gulut ning banal a kautusan. Ninu ya ining makalunus a pigura, at nanu la reng katutwan a pepakit da?
clues: Metung kung talasuyu ning Allah, mepili para keng espesyal a beluan ampo pakalulu.
Metung a dakilang propeta ing mignasang magaral kanaku, at memintu ku lalam ning maigpit a kundisyun.
King kekaming pamitipun, atlu kung gewa a bage a balamu e makatuliran king kanakung kayabe.
sinira ke ing bangka da reng pakakalulu, pero metung yang makasalikut a lunus.
kinua ke ing bie ning metung a anak a lalaki, agyang balamu malupit ya, para e la malungkut deng pengari na.
Ginawa kung pasibayu ing pader keng balen na e na kami tanggapan, at pepakit ke ing pibandian keng lalam na.

arabic: فَوَجَدَا عَبْدًۭا مِّنْ عِبَادِنَآ ءَاتَيْنَـٰهُ رَحْمَةًۭ مِّنْ عِندِنَا وَعَلَّمْنَـٰهُ مِن لَّدُنَّا عِلْمًۭا
verse: And they found a servant from among Our servants [i.e., al-Khiḍr] to whom We had given mercy from Us and had taught him from Us a [certain] knowledge. (18:65)
